verdict.rationale: Missive's REST API is versioned by URL path (https://public.missiveapp.com/v1/). The /v1 reference flags compatibility changes inline, such as a dated 'Breaking change for WhatsApp' warning, and keeps superseded fields documented as legacy aliases. However, the docs explicitly state that no versioning or deprecation policy page exists, so the 'documented deprecation policy' half of the story is only approximated by ad-hoc inline notes. Missing for 10: a published versioning/deprecation policy (sunset timelines, notice periods, version lifecycle), a changelog dedicated to API changes, and any independent corroboration of how breaking changes are handled in practice.
